raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`FluxTransformer2DModel` inherits the empty `_compile_conditions` from `BaseDiT`, so `--enable-torch-compile true --regional-compile true` on FLUX.1 fails at startup:

```
ValueError: regional compile found no matching submodules; check FluxTransformer2DModel._compile_conditions
```

## Modifications

Declare the regions: every `FluxTransformerBlock` (double-stream) and `FluxSingleTransformerBlock` (single-stream), 57 for FLUX.1-dev.

## Accuracy Tests

Same modules, same compile mode as whole-model compile; only the compile granularity changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GB300, FLUX.1-dev 1024², 50 steps, TP2, served. Median of 5 requests after 2 warmups, fresh server per arm, 2 interleaved rounds. NUMA-bound workers (#43565) and compile fixes applied in all arms.

| Arm | Round 1 | Round 2 |
|---|---|---|
| eager | 4.06 s | 3.86 s |
| whole-model compile | 4.03 s | 3.93 s |
| regional compile (this PR; failed to start before) | 3.70 s | 3.90 s |

Startup log: `Enabled regional torch.compile for 57 submodules in FluxTransformer2DModel`. The remaining graph breaks in both compile modes are the TP all-reduce (`Communicator.get_world_size` is not traceable), which is a follow-up.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests: `test_regional_torch_compile.py::test_flux_compile_conditions_match_both_block_types`. The file passes: 11 passed.
- [ ] Update documentation: N/A.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

@@ -1196,6 +1196,11 @@ class FluxTransformer2DModel(CachableDiT, LayerwiseOffloadableModuleMixin):
     Reference: https://blackforestlabs.ai/announcing-black-forest-labs/
     """
 
+    _compile_conditions = [
+        lambda name, module: isinstance(
+            module, (FluxTransformerBlock, FluxSingleTransformerBlock)
+        )
+    ]
     param_names_mapping = FluxConfig().arch_config.param_names_mapping
 
     @classmethod

@@ -5,6 +5,11 @@
 import pytest
 import torch.nn as nn
 
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.flux import (
+    FluxSingleTransformerBlock,
+    FluxTransformer2DModel,
+    FluxTransformerBlock,
+)
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.ltx_2 import (
     LTX2VideoTransformer3DModel,
 )
@@ -195,6 +200,18 @@ def test_ltx2_compile_conditions_match_only_direct_blocks():
     )
 
 
+def test_flux_compile_conditions_match_both_block_types():
+    def matches(module) -> bool:
+        return any(
+            condition("transformer_blocks.0", module)
+            for condition in FluxTransformer2DModel._compile_conditions
+        )
+
+    assert matches(FluxTransformerBlock.__new__(FluxTransformerBlock))
+    assert matches(FluxSingleTransformerBlock.__new__(FluxSingleTransformerBlock))
+    assert not matches(nn.Linear(2, 2))
+
+
 def test_compile_matching_submodules_matches_only_declared_regions():
     model = _RegionalModel()
